target_customer: Teams and developers running coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) who want to cut tool calls, tokens and latency
problem: Agents re-plan the same tasks from scratch every run, wasting tokens, tool calls and time. Memorable records successful workflows as a graph and replays them for similar prompts.
business_model: Developer tool with CLI and hosted dashboard; free lifetime Pro plan offered to design partners; pricing not published
product_category: Procedural memory layer for AI agents

founders.name: Nikhil Krishnaswamy
founders.background_notes: YC page says he built an iOS MCP while interning and has research published in COLM and IEEE.

founders.name: Advaiyt Sane
education: Carnegie Mellon, computer science (class of 2029 per YC page)
founders.background_notes: Built developer tools at Nvidia for autonomous vehicle test generation per YC page.

competitors.name: Mem0
competitors.what: Memory layer for AI apps and agents
competitors.traction_then: Funded and widely used per press
competitors.funding_then: 24M USD seed plus Series A announced Oct 2025

competitors.name: Letta and Zep
competitors.what: Agent memory systems; Letta lets agents edit their own memory, Zep builds on a temporal knowledge graph

technical_complexity.rationale: Trace capture, graph storage and prompt injection across several agent harnesses is standard engineering, but making replayed procedures reliable is a real research question.

defensibility.rationale: Stored procedures could create some lock-in, but agent vendors and many memory startups can build similar features quickly.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Too recent to know; agent platforms already ship memory and skills features.

market_need_then: Rapid adoption of coding agents in 2026 made token cost and repeated planning a visible pain, and the site cites design partner case studies (OpenHome, gstack, Quartermaster) with claimed gains. Claims are the company's own.

branding.domain_note: Uses memorable.sh, a .sh developer TLD, not the .com; a separate company Memorable AI (acquired by Reddit in 2024) shares the name.

identity.visual_style: Minimal developer tool site built on Next.js and Tailwind per a directory
identity.voice_and_tone: Technical and claim driven, with benchmark numbers

branding.community_and_virality: Launch post by a YC visiting partner and a public comment by YC's president noted on the site; no wider community evidence found.

brand_strength.rationale: Very early; the common English word is easy to remember but collides with another company and with similarly named memory tools (memories.sh), which shows up in search results.

outcome_analysis: Memorable is a two person company that launched in September 2026 and is too early for an outcome. It targets a clear and growing pain, the cost of agents re-planning tasks, with early design partners, but competes with funded memory startups and with agent platforms that can ship the same feature.
notes: Directory lists batch as Summer 2027 while the company was founded in 2026 and launched September 2026; the batch label is as given by YC. No funding found beyond the YC standard deal; no outcome news found (an acquisition hit was for a different company, Memorable AI). Competitor list is as of the 2026 launch, from 2025 and 2026 sources.
